# STM32F4 CMSIS device headers

Unmodified subset of https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/cmsis-device-f4,
release v2.6.10, commit 5f41fb29d22773896c780052bf61e47fc924d524.
Only STM32F407 and its system declarations are included. See LICENSE.md.
HomeCore provides clock initialization; ST's system/startup sources are not linked.
